# EO2Weave (怡氧知知)

> AI-native creator workspace with local-first files, knowledge workflows, and
> multi-agent orchestration. Runs entirely in the browser as a PWA; files stay
> on the user's machine (OPFS / native disk), never on our servers.

EO2Weave 是面向创作者的 AI 原生工作台：本地优先的文件管理、知识工作流与多智能体
编排。纯浏览器 PWA，文件保存在用户本机（OPFS / 本地磁盘），不上传服务器。

## What makes it different

- **Local-first**: documents and workspaces live in the browser's OPFS or the
  user's local disk via a native host. No cloud copy by default.
- **Multi-agent**: orchestrates coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode)
  as subagents, plus its own built-in agent loop with tool calling.
- **WebMCP-native**: the app itself is addressable by external AI agents via
  the WebMCP protocol — agents can create projects, manage conversations,
  read/write workspace files, and drive the built-in agent on the user's behalf.

## Sites

- International: https://weave.eo2suite.com
- China: https://weave.eo2suite.cn

## For AI agents (WebMCP)

EO2Weave's own page registers 20 WebMCP tools on `navigator.modelContext`
(Chrome 140+, polyfilled otherwise), including:

- list_projects / create_project
- list_conversations / search_conversations / get_messages / send_message
- read_folder_file / write_folder_file / list_folder_files
- list_providers / list_models / set_default_model

Tools are discovered dynamically per open tab; AI agents with WebMCP support
(e.g. Chrome with the WebMCP API, or the EO2Weave browser extension) can invoke
them after user authorization.
